message.reasoning:
The user says (in Polish): "stwórz w css kartę która będzie się obracać po najechaniu kursorem". That translates to: "create in CSS a card that will rotate on hover with the cursor." So they want CSS code for a rotating card effect on hover.

We need to provide CSS code that creates a card element that rotates when hovered. We can give an example using transform: rotateY(180deg) or rotateX etc. Provide HTML structure too? They asked "stwórz w css kartę" meaning "create in CSS a card". Usually you need HTML markup as well. But we can just provide CSS snippet and explain usage. Provide minimal example: container with perspective, inner card with backface-visibility hidden, front and back faces. On hover, rotate. Provide CSS and maybe small HTML skeleton.

Thus answer: Provide CSS code and explanation. Use .card-container { perspective: 1000px; } .card { width: 300px; height: 200px; position: relative; transition: transform 0.8s; transform-style: preserve-3d; } .card:hover { transform: rotateY(180deg); } .card-face { position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; backface-visibility: hidden; } .card-front { background: #fff; } .card-back { background: #f00; transform: rotateY(180deg); }

Also mention customizing rotation axis, speed, etc.
